text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: alert: increased 5xx rate observed for egress NAT in eu-north1 starting ~00:02 UTC. Autoscaling ok, but egress path errors ~30% for short-lived connections. Paging primary on-call (Dana P)
Ana K: paging now. Moved to #incidents with severity:sev2. Adding network triage.
Mike L: I can shadow for logs and customer impact calc. where are the main failing pods?
Sarita R: seeing tcp resets on nat-gw-3 and nat-gw-4, SNAT ports exhaustion on both AZ A and B. flows spike from batch export jobs.
Dana P: taking first touch. thanks. attaching quick check list: runbook-> Networking / NAT port exhaustion. will confirm.
Dana P: @NOC Bot can you fetch recent VPC flow summaries for nat-gw-3?
NOC Bot: fetched flow samples (last 5m).  p95 connection count increased 3.8x on nat-gw-3. Port usage near 96%.
Mike L: copying metric: `sum by (instance) (nat_port_utilization)` shows nat-gw-3 95.8% nat-gw-4 92.3%
Ana K: impact: some hosted customers report generation timeouts and 502s. internal errors spike on router layer. we should prep statuspage text.
Statuspage Bot: suggested template: "We are investigating elevated error rates for API requests routed via eu-north1 egress. Some customers may experience request failures and higher latency. Engineers are triaging. Updates every 15 minutes."
Dana P: draft for customers: short + actionable. prefer: "We're currently investigating request failures affecting EU workloads. We recommend configuring retry/backoff and/or switching to eu-central1 region temporarily. We will post ETA for full mitigation."
Sarita R: mitigation options: 1) restart nat-gw-3 (risky, causes transient connections loss), 2) move heavy batch exports to off-peak / throttled jobs, 3) divert new sessions to eu-central1 via routing policy.
Mike L: quick patch: add temp rate limit on export-worker autoscale group: `kubectl patch hpa export-worker -p '{\"spec\":{\"maxReplicas\":40}}'` — that reduces new connections.
Dana P: I'll coordinate reroute. Ana — can you hold statuspage update and customer DM until we confirm routing works?
Ana K: on it. Drafting statuspage now. Using conservative language and include workaround to route to eu-central1.
Mike L: Network team: can we allocate extra NAT ports by spinning additional nat-gw instance in AZ C?
Sarita R: AZ C doesn't currently have spare NAT instances in this account. Spinning one up will take ~5-8m and requires firewall attach. we can do it but must schedule.
Dana P: Plan: 1) Apply temp HPA cap on export workers (Mike) — in progress. 2) Spin additional nat-gw in AZ C (Sarita) — go. 3) Update routing policy to prefer eu-central1 for new sessions (Ana + me) — prepare config and small canary. 4) Notify customers via statuspage and targeted DM (Ana).
Mike L: HPA patch applied. monitoring connection counts.
Sarita R: creating NAT instance in AZ C now: `terraform apply -target=module.network.nat_gw_eu_north1_c` — kicked off.
NOC Bot: terraform apply completed in 6m. NAT gw provisioned: nat-gw-5. Port usage redistributed, p95 down to 58% on nat-gw-3/4/5 aggregated.
Dana P: routing canary config prepared: will change router policy to prefer eu-central1 for the canary prefix 10% of traffic. Command: `redwood-router update-policy --region eu-north1 --prefer eu-central1 --canary 10`
Ana K: statuspage update ready. Draft: "Investigating elevated request failures for customers routed through eu-north1 egress. We have provisioned additional egress capacity and initiated a partial traffic diversion to eu-central1. Some requests may still see failures; recommended temporary workaround is to use eu-central1 endpoints or enable retries. Next update in 15 minutes." Approving?
Sarita R: approve. add note about mitigation steps (nat capacity and canary diversion). keep non-technical line for customers.
Statuspage Bot: status page posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/IO-2026-eu-north1-egress (incident id IO-2026)
Mike L: monitoring errors on top customers list. creating DM template for impacted customers: "We're investigating elevated error rates for EU endpoints. We've provisioned additional egress capacity and are diverting a portion of traffic to eu-central1. If you can, temporarily point traffic to eu-central1 or add retry/backoff. We'll follow up with root cause and ETA."
Ana K: sending DMs to top-10 impacted accounts now. copy in AE and CSMs.
Dana P: handoff note for next on-call (in 30m): mitigation in place, nat ports relieved, canary diversion active 10%. next steps: observe for 30-60m, escalate to network infra if errors persist (>5% 5xx sustained), prepare full cutover to eu-central1 if necessary.
Mike L: logging note: saved pcap of failed sessions to /var/logs/incidents/1875001234/ for postmortem.
Sarita R: keeping terraform change to nat-gw tracked. will open PR for allowing autoscale of nat-gw pool.
Dana P: closing loop: current status — severity downgraded to sev3 (partial impact), nat capacity scaled, canary diversion healthy, statuspage updated, customer DMs sent. will re-evaluate at 1875002830 UTC.
Ana K: thanks team. will prepare internal comms template for postmortem and customer follow-up after RCA. :thumbsup:
